```{r}
set.seed(42)
for (i in seq_len(20)){
  j <- i^3
  print(j)
}
for (i in seq_len(5)){
  j <- paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse="")
  print(j)
}
library(cowsay)
species <- c("alligator", "anxiouscat", "bat2", "behindcat",
  "bigcat", "blowfish", "buffalo", "cat", "chicken", "cow_borg", "cow_dead",
  "cow_greedy", "cow_sleepy", "cow_tired", "cow_wired", "cow_young", "cow", "daemon", "dragon",
  "duck", "duckling", "egret", "endlesshorse", "facecat", "fish", "frog", "ghost", "goldfish",
  "grumpycat", "hypnotoad", "longcat", "longtailcat", "monkey", "mushroom", "owl", "rabbit", "shark", "shortcat", "signbunny", "smallcat", "snowman", "spider",
  "squirrel", "squirrel2", "stegosaurus", "stretchycat", "turkey", "whale", "wolf",
  "yoda")

for (spp in species) {
  say(paste("I am a", spp), by = spp)
}
```
